simple.meaning: פֹּה (pôh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “this place (French ici), i.e. here or hence.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 82 times across Genesis, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 19:12. Its contexts include family, family line, Torah, city, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פֹּה (H6311).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: פֹּה (pôh) / H6311 is traced through Genesis 19:12, Genesis 22:5, Genesis 40:15, Numbers 22:8 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H6311. poh or po or po מֹּה 58 , and (Ezekiel 40-41, 23 out of 35 t.) מּוֺ , also Job 38:11 b מֹּא , adverb of location here, hither (probably from the same demonstrative √ found in so, then (often in apodosis), אֵפוֺא אַף, : compare Kö ii. l, 247 f., 243, 331 f. ): — 1 here: a. Gen 19:12 מֹּה מִילְֿךָ עֹד whom hast thou still here ? 22:5 מֹּה לָכֶם שְׁבוּ , 40:15 ; Num 22:8 ; 32:16 ; Deut 5:28 ; 12:8 ; Judg 4:20 אִישׁ מֹּה הֲיֵשׁ , 2Kin 3:11 , etc.; asked in some surprise, Judg 18:3 פֹה מַהלְּֿךָ = what is thy business here ? simil. 1Kin 19:9 , 13 ; Isa 22:16 ; 52:5 מַהלִּֿיפֹֿה וְעַתָּה . compare the synonym כֹּה בָּזֶה, 2. b. עַדמֹּֿה Job 38:11 a. c. מִמֹּה or מִמּוֺ , only Ezekiel 40-41, and always (except Ezek 40:12 a, where it must be supplied with ᵑ6 ᵐ5 ) repeated, on this side ... on that side (compare מִזֶּה ֗֗֗ מִזֶּה ), 40:10 (twice in verse); 40:12 b; 40:21 (twice in verse), etc. d. with the interrogative אֵיפֹה אֵי, where ? . 2 after a verb of motion , hither , 1Sam 16:11 פֹה עַדבּֿאֹוֺ , Ezra 4:2 .
